articles.title: USA withdraw from U17 World Cup
articles.summary: The USA pull out of the Under-17 World Cup, which starts in Qatar next week, because of the risk of armed conflict.

articles.title: 'Concern is high' as Curry exits Warriors loss with abdominal injury
articles.summary: Four-time NBA champion Steph Curry exited the Golden State Warriors' 115-108 loss to the Houston Rockets with right abdominal soreness.
